description: PAID. Adds one component to an existing project. Returns the transitive registry closure in dependency-first install order, the single `expo install` line for the whole closure, every file with its exact target path, the provider nesting it needs, and its runtime rules. It replaces fetching /r/*.json by hand: a component is a closure, not a file, and the ways to get that wrong all fail silently. Foundation components need no licence key.
name: install_component
title: Install a component
